summary: The candidate prevents the common one-image plus one contiguous literal-marker request from reaching the legacy loader mismatch, and text-only input remains unchanged. It does not preserve exact ordinary user/tool text in mixed requests: the escaped re-render is the prompt that is encoded for the model. More importantly, a literal marker split across adjacent user text parts is reassembled by the chat template after the per-part neutralization, producing two complete markers for one attachment and reproducing the original empty-detail RuntimeError. The candidate regression passes because it inspects the discarded first render rather than asserting the encoded model input and does not test cross-part marker assembly.

tests.what_was_measured: On recorded base 358c163, one real image marker plus one literal complete marker enters legacy_load_mm_data and raises RuntimeError('An exception occurred while loading multimodal data: '); a one-marker control loads exactly one 1x1 PNG.
At exact candidate commit 1fefcc22, candidate-selected regression tests: 4 passed, 9 subtests passed.

At exact candidate commit, the encoded mixed user and tool prompts contain escaped rather than exact literal content. A marker split across adjacent text parts yields two complete markers for one image and the legacy loader raises the same empty-detail RuntimeError.
At exact candidate commit, the full serving_chat unit file passed: 139 tests and 77 subtests.

One AMD Instinct MI350X was visible under torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015; GPU versus CPU max absolute error was 7.62939453125e-06 and allclose was true. This establishes GPU availability only, not Qwen-VL serving correctness.

gpu_execution.evidence: A deterministic torch matrix multiplication ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X. No Qwen3.8-27B weights were available, so no model-serving inference was run.

remaining_counterexamples: With one real image, splitting <|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|> across two adjacent user text parts bypasses per-part neutralization; template concatenation recreates the full marker and legacy_load_mm_data still raises the original empty-detail RuntimeError.
In mixed image plus user text, the exact literal special-token spelling is replaced with spaced spellings in the prompt encoded for the model.
In mixed image plus tool-result text, the exact literal special-token spelling is replaced with spaced spellings in the prompt encoded for the model.
remaining_limitations: Qwen3.8-27B weights and a qualified Qwen-VL runtime were unavailable, so full OpenAI HTTP serving and semantic inference were not verified.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture was not used because it cannot qualify Qwen-VL prompt rendering or multimodal processing.
No C/C++/CUDA/HIP/native files differ between the recorded base and candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
The parser and loader paths were exercised with the repository implementation and a real decoded 1x1 PNG; model architecture behavior beyond these boundaries remains unverified.
